# My Software Engineering Journey

> Personal technical blog by Carlos Martin Sanchez (Engineering Lead at MongoDB). Deep dives, architectural patterns, practical guides, and lessons learned in full-stack web development, AI engineering, TypeScript, React, Go, Java, Python, and C++.

- **Author**: Carlos Martin Sanchez
- **Website**: https://carlosvin.github.io
- **About**: https://carlosvin.github.io/about/
- **GitHub**: https://github.com/carlosvin
- **LinkedIn**: https://linkedin.com/in/carlosvin
- **RSS Feed**: https://carlosvin.github.io/rss.xml
- **Atom Feed**: https://carlosvin.github.io/atom.xml

---

## Featured Full-Stack & AI Architecture Guides

- [Building AI-Promptable Full-Stack Apps with TanStack Start](https://carlosvin.github.io/building-ai-promptable-fullstack-apps/): A reproducible full-stack architecture for AI-promptable web apps with TanStack Start, three-layer schemas (Zod), swappable repository interfaces, server function boundaries, isomorphic loaders, and Agent Skills.
- [TanStack Router: Opinionated Guidelines for Production React Apps](https://carlosvin.github.io/tanstack-router-opinionated-conventions-production-react-apps/): Production best practices for type-safe routing, URL-as-state search params, route loaders, mutations, and caching conventions in React.
- [React TypeScript with Parcel](https://carlosvin.github.io/react-typescript-parcel/): Setting up lightweight, zero-config React + TypeScript projects with Parcel bundler.
- [PWA Lessons Learned: CRA and Service Workers](https://carlosvin.github.io/pwa-lessons-learned-cra/): Real-world lessons from progressive web application development and service worker caching strategies.

## Backend, APIs & Systems Engineering

- [REST URLs Design](https://carlosvin.github.io/rest-urls/): Practical design rules, HTTP verbs, resource identifiers, nested collections, and common anti-patterns when designing REST APIs.
- [REST Service in Go vs Java](https://carlosvin.github.io/rest-service-go-vs-java/): Architecture and performance comparison when building microservices in Go versus Java.
- [Easily creating a Golang CLI Tool](https://carlosvin.github.io/create-cmd-tool-golang/): Building robust CLI utilities in Go with flag parsing, environment configuration, and Meta-Viper.
- [Embedded Java Databases Performance Comparison](https://carlosvin.github.io/java-embedded-db-performance-comparison/): Benchmark and performance evaluation between SQLite, DerbyDB/JavaDB, and ObjectDB in Java.
- [Java Serialization vs Externalizable](https://carlosvin.github.io/serialization-java-serializable-externalizable/): Deep dive into standard Java serialization mechanisms versus custom Externalizable implementations.
- [Creating Custom Maven Plugins](https://carlosvin.github.io/creating-custom-maven-plugin/): Step-by-step guide to developing reusable custom Maven plugins for build automation.
- [Reverse Proxy Multidomain with Docker](https://carlosvin.github.io/reverse-proxy-multidomain-docker/): Multi-tenant routing and reverse proxy configuration using Docker containers.

## Testing & Automation

- [Pytest Scenarios for Isolated Integration Tests](https://carlosvin.github.io/pytest-scenarios-isolated-integration-tests/): Organizing reproducible, isolated database and integration test scenarios in Python with Pytest fixtures.
- [Cypress Parameterized Dynamic Tests](https://carlosvin.github.io/cypress-parametrized-dynamic-tests/): Generating data-driven end-to-end test suites dynamically in Cypress.

## C++ & Performance Engineering

- [Mutex in C++](https://carlosvin.github.io/cpp-mutex/): Transitioning from C++98 pthread mutexes to C++11 std::mutex and RAII lock guards.
- [Filesystem in C++17](https://carlosvin.github.io/recursive-directory-iterator/): Practical usage of std::filesystem and recursive directory iterators in modern C++.
- [Choosing a Modern C++ Stack](https://carlosvin.github.io/choosing-modern-cpp-stack/): Modern build systems (Meson) and unit testing frameworks (Doctest, Catch) for C++.
- [C++ Struct Memory Alignment & Pragma Pack](https://carlosvin.github.io/cpp-pragma-pack/): Memory padding, structure alignment, CPU cache implications, and the #pragma pack preprocessor directive.
- [Building C++ with Gradle](https://carlosvin.github.io/gradle-cpp/): Multi-platform C++ compilation and dependency management with Gradle.
- [Debugging Libraries Generated with Libtool](https://carlosvin.github.io/debug-libtool-lib/): Troubleshooting and debugging shared libraries produced with GNU Autotools / Libtool.

## Python & Text Utilities

- [Remove and Replace Punctuation in Python](https://carlosvin.github.io/remove-replace-punctuation-py/): High-performance string manipulation and regex cleaning in Python.
- [Normalize Text in Python](https://carlosvin.github.io/normalize-text-py/): Unicode normalization, diacritics removal, and case folding techniques.
- [Delete HTML Tags in Python / Django](https://carlosvin.github.io/delete-html-tags-py-django/): Sanitizing user input and stripping HTML tags cleanly.

## Key Topics & Tags

- [AI & Agents](https://carlosvin.github.io/tags/ai/): AI agent skills, tool calling, promptable architectures.

- [TypeScript](https://carlosvin.github.io/tags/typescript/): Type-safe systems, runtime schema validation (Zod, ArkType).
- [TanStack Router](https://carlosvin.github.io/tags/tanstack-router/): Production routing conventions and loaders.
- [Go / Golang](https://carlosvin.github.io/tags/golang/): CLI tools, microservices, concurrency.
- [Java](https://carlosvin.github.io/tags/java/): Databases, performance benchmarks, build plugins.
- [Python](https://carlosvin.github.io/tags/python/): Pytest fixtures, integration tests, text normalization.
- [C++](https://carlosvin.github.io/tags/cpp/): Memory alignment, multithreading, C++17 filesystem.
- [Architecture](https://carlosvin.github.io/tags/architecture/): Software design patterns, interfaces, boundary mapping.
- [Testing](https://carlosvin.github.io/tags/testing/): Unit, integration, and end-to-end testing methodologies.
